[PATH:theoretical] Analytical derivation of a mean-field Fokker-Planck equation for the activation distribution in the high-coupling limit, incorporating stochastic activation noise and parameter coupling as a diffusion coefficient. — Provides a formal mathematical model predicting the critical threshold and contraction behavior.
